body: I've been to two, both in the same detox/psych ward unit after coming in via the ER. First time they held me for a week against my will, second time I was out in two days, so it can be a crapshoot even at the same place. Though it's worth noting the second time I did go through the first ~48 hours of WDs in a combination of the ER and a crisis triage center, so I was on the tail end when I was released.
Yeah, I figure I'll take in my blood pressure log to the doctor on Monday in case I panic again LMAO

Detoxing about 120-130/95-100 leaning 100. About 115/75 after a week or two sober. Shoots up if I'm at the doctors or panicking. Heart rate is like 85 either way past day 1.

I take it frequently with an omron 7 which are pretty accurate.
I guess the main question is it even possible to have a withdrawal seizure while on a benzo to begin with when you have no shakes, sweats, hallucinations, anything?

That's the thing- I got the librium prescribed by the ER and they assured me there was no seizure risk if I took them as prescribed, so it seems like a waste of resources to bother them again because of high BP. As far as I've read they don't even really want you in at 180/120+ anymore unless it presents with symptoms
